abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Stoneheart Worldhammer is 3.

abilities.name: Rain of Stone
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. Add 2 to the roll if the target charged this turn. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: With the Force of a Landslide
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Stoneheart Worldhammer for each instance of Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain depicted on your battle scripture.

abilities.name: Fortitude of the Earth
abilities.effect: While you have 2 or more instances of Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain depicted on your battle scripture, this unit's Save characteristic is 3+.

abilities.name: Strength of Stone
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Alarith Stoneguard unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn: • Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's melee weapons. • The target cannot make pile-in moves.

abilities.name: Raise the Earth
abilities.declare: Pick an objective within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a non-Fly unit (friendly or enemy) that is contesting the target objective uses a Move ability, inflict D6 mortal damage on that unit after that ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Elemental Endurance
abilities.effect: If this unit is picked to be a target of the 'Depict Rune' ability, for the rest of that battle round, when resolving the damage sequence for a friendly Lumineth Realm-lords unit while it is wholly within 12" of this unit, if you spend rage dice as part of the 'Fight Through the Pain' ability, remove 1 damage point from that unit's damage pool on a 2+ instead of a 3+.

abilities.name: Earth's Grip
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit that has no more than 1 model and is within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle, the target is gripped until this unit is destroyed, the target breaks free or you pick a different target for this spell. While the target is gripped, each time it uses a Move ability, your opponent must roll a dice as a reaction and add their fury level to the roll. On a 7+, the target breaks free. Otherwise, that Move ability has no effect.

units.name: Archmage Teclis and Celennar, Spirit of Hysh

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of Celennar's Moonbright Talons is 3.

abilities.name: Aura of Celennar
abilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls and banishment rolls for friendly Lumineth Realm‑lords Wizards while they are wholly within 12" of this unit. In addition, this unit can use Spell abilities from the Lore of Hysh, the Lore of Awakened Realms, and the warscrolls of all friendly Lumineth Realm-lords Wizards on the battlefield.

abilities.name: Archmage
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following: *Magical Supremacy:* Instead of making a casting roll for the next Spell ability used by this unit this turn, you can use a value of 12 for the roll that cannot be modified. *Drain Power*: Pick a visible enemy Wizard or Priest within 18" of this unit to be the target. Subtract 1 from the target's power level, to a minimum of 0, until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Discs of the Aelementiri
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: You cannot use this ability in the first battle round.
abilities.effect: Depict a rune of your choice on your battle scripture. Designer's Note: *This allows you to have that rune depicted earlier in the battle scripture for the purposes of other abilities. Do not resolve the effect of the 'Depict Rune' ability as part of this ability. There is a smaller diamond in the battle scripture diamond in the Rules Reference where you can record this extra rune.*

abilities.name: The Light of Truth
abilities.declare: Pick any number of different visible enemy units within 18" of this unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Firestealer Hammers is 4.

abilities.name: Call of the Mountains
abilities.effect: While a visible friendly Alarith unit is wholly within 12" of this unit: • You are treated as having 1 additional instance of Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain depicted on your battle scripture for the purposes of the abilities on that unit's warscroll. • If that unit is picked to be the target of the 'Depict Rune' ability, you can apply the enhanced effects of that ability to that unit as if you had an instance of Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain on your battle scripture.

abilities.name: Unbreakable Bulwark
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, while that enemy unit is in combat with this unit, all attacks made by models in that unit within this unit's combat range must target this unit.

abilities.name: With the Force of a Landslide
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Firestealer Hammers for each instance of Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain depicted on your battle scripture.

abilities.name: Total Eclipse
abilities.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the first time an enemy unit within 18" of this unit uses a command, unless your opponent spends 1 additional command point, the command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.

abilities.name: Equal Prodigies
abilities.declare: Pick whether Ellania leads or Ellathor leads.
abilities.effect: If Ellania leads, until the start of your next turn, add 1 to this unit's power level and it has Ward (4+). If Ellathor leads, until the start of your next turn, add the current battle round number to the Damage characteristic of Altairi.

abilities.name: Sudden Translocation
abilities.declare: This unit can only use this ability if any enemy models were slain this turn by this unit's combat attacks.
abilities.effect: Heal (D6) this unit. Then, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Hunters of Majestic Beasts
abilities.effect: The Damage characteristic of this unit's Bow of the Wind's Vengeance is 3 for attacks that target Monsters.

abilities.name: Spirit of the Wind
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit used a Shoot ability this phase, this unit can move D6". Add 2 to the roll for each instance of Oreali, Rune of the Wind depicted on your battle scripture. It cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Hurricane Winds
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's shooting attacks to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Guided by the Winds
abilities.effect: While you have 2 or more instances of Oreali, Rune of the Wind depicted on your battle scripture, add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit's Windcharger Bows.

abilities.name: Windleap
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly Hurakan units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, each target can use a Run ability and still use Shoot and/or Charge abilities later in the turn.

abilities.name: Transporting Vortex
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Lumineth Realm‑lords unit wholly within 12" of this unit and not in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Focused Fury
abilities.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6. Add 2 to the roll if this unit is in combat.
abilities.effect: This unit has Strike-first for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Champion of the Lord Phoenix
abilities.effect: While a visible friendly Vanari unit is wholly within 12" of this unit: • You are treated as having 1 additional instance of Varinor, Rune of Strength depicted on your battle scripture for the purposes of the abilities on that unit's warscroll. • If that unit is picked to be the target of the 'Depict Rune' ability, you can apply the enhanced effects of that ability to that unit as if you had an instance of Varinor, Rune of Strength on your battle scripture.

abilities.name: Myari Lightcaller
abilities.effect: While this unit's Myari Lightcaller is on the battlefield, it has Wizard (1) and the Scinari keyword.

abilities.name: Dazzling Light
abilities.declare: Pick an objective that you do not control that is within 18" of and visible to this unit's Myari Lightcaller, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units that are contesting that objective.

abilities.name: Realmscribe
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: You declared the 'Depict Rune' ability
abilities.effect: Replace 1 instance of a rune on your battle scripture with 1 of the following: • Varinor, Rune of Strength • Ydriliqi, Rune of the River • Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain • Oreali, Rune of the Wind

abilities.name: Darkness of the Soul
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Rune of Enthlai
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared an Unlimited Spell ability for this unit
abilities.effect: If that spell is successfully cast, roll a dice. On a 4+, after resolving the effect of that spell, this unit can immediately cast that spell a second time using the same casting roll. Do not count the second spell towards the number of Spell abilities this unit can use this turn.

abilities.name: Clarity of Thought
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Lumineth Realm‑lords Infantry unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, attacks that target that friendly unit cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).

abilities.name: Arcane Discovery
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a non-Faction Terrain terrain feature within 3" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to casting rolls for units (friendly and enemy) while they are within 3" of the target.

abilities.name: Independent Operative
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Arcane Nullification
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy Hero within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat with the target, the corresponding effect below applies until the start of your next turn. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, the corresponding effect below applies until the start of your next turn: *Holder of Forbidden Treasures*: If the target has an artefact of power, that artefact of power has no effect. *An Insignificant Underling*: If the target does not have an artefact of power, other than the Companion weapon ability, weapon abilities for the target's combat attacks have no effect.

abilities.name: Leashed Fury
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, for the rest of the turn: • Each time this unit is picked to use the 'Eruption of Fury' ability, if you spend 1 rage dice as part of that ability, it counts as 3 rage dice. • This unit can be picked to use the 'Eruption of Fury' ability even if you have already used it this turn.

units.name: Sevireth, Lord of the Seventh Wind

abilities.name: Call of the Winds
abilities.effect: While a visible friendly Hurakan unit is wholly within 12" of this unit: • You are treated as having 1 additional instance of Oreali, Rune of the Wind depicted on your battle scripture for the purposes of the abilities on that unit's warscroll. • If that unit is picked to be the target of the 'Depict Rune' ability, you can apply the enhanced effects of that ability to that unit as if you had an instance of Oreali, Rune of the Wind on your battle scripture.

abilities.name: Searing Desert Winds
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 visible enemy units within 6" of this unit this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll and subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Spirit of the Wind
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit used a Shoot ability this phase, this unit can move D6". Add 2 to the roll for each instance of Oreali, Rune of the Wind depicted on your battle scripture. It cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Supreme Swordmaster
abilities.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit's attacks.

abilities.name: Valorous Intervention
abilities.declare: This unit cannot use this ability if it is in combat. Pick a friendly Lumineth Realm-lords unit that is in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target, within 1" of an enemy unit and in combat. This unit has charged.

units.name: The Light of Eltharion (Scourge of Ghyran)

abilities.name: Supreme Swordmaster
abilities.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit's attacks. In addition, ignore negative modifiers to the characteristics of this unit's melee weapons.

abilities.name: Eternal Light
abilities.effect: If this unit is destroyed and if a friendly Lumineth Realm-lords Wizard successfully casts a Summon spell, instead of resolving the effect of that Summon spell, you can set up a replacement unit for this unit more than 9" from all enemy units and wholly within 12" of the unit that used that Summon spell. This ability is still in effect even if this unit is not on the battlefield.

abilities.name: Masters of the Zephyr
abilities.effect: This unit's Tzul is a token. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place its Tzul next to it. • While this unit's Tzul is next to it, it has Fly. • While this unit's Thyrielle is on the battlefield, it has Wizard (1).

abilities.name: One with the Wind
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Infantry or Cavalry unit that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Place this unit's Tzul next to the target.

abilities.name: The Living Gale
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit with this unit's Tzul next to it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Place this unit's Tzul next to this unit. • You can move the target up to D3". • Then, if this unit is within 6" of the target, you can move this unit up to D6". It cannot end that move in combat. Add 2" to the distance each unit can move for each instance of Oreali, Rune of the Wind depicted on your battle scripture. Designer's Note: *If your opponent would prefer to move their own models, pre-measure the distance and indicate where they should move their models to.*

abilities.name: Lofted Shots
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit's Auralan Bows but subtract 1 from hit rolls for this unit's shooting attacks.

abilities.name: Anticipated Strike
abilities.effect: If this unit has not charged this turn, ignore the effect of the Charge (+1 Damage) ability for combat attacks made by enemy units that target this unit.

abilities.name: World Banner
abilities.effect: While a visible friendly Lumineth Realm-lords unit is wholly within 12" of this unit, it can use the 'Rally' command even if it is in combat.

abilities.name: Defend the Banner
abilities.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for friendly Vanari Infantry units while they are contesting the same objective as this unit.

abilities.name: Masters of Combat
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's Sunmental Blades for each instance of Varinor, Rune of Strength depicted on your battle scripture.

abilities.name: Guardians of the Scinari
abilities.effect: While any friendly Scinari Heroes are wholly within this unit's combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have Ward (5+).

abilities.name: Dawnrider Charge
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's Dawnrider Lances and Blades if it charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: Shining Example
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly Lumineth Realm-lords unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

abilities.name: Wall of Blades
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Vanari Auralan Wardens unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the wall of blades. Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the wall of blades to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the wall of blades that is within 3" of the target. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Lead the Charge
abilities.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for friendly Lumineth Realm-lords units while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.

abilities.name: Purest Aetherquartz
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's attacks and subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.

abilities.name: Blinding Bolts
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by all this unit's shooting attacks this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is a Monster. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Scryhawks
abilities.effect: Add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit's Starshard Bolts while it is wholly within 12" of any friendly Vanari Auralan Sentinels units.

abilities.name: Relentless as the Driving Current
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 2D6". It can pass through models in enemy units but must end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Travel the Waterways
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked to depict Ydriliqui, Rune of the River on your battle scripture this battle round, you can instead set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Depict Rune
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.effect: Pick 1 of the following runes to depict on your battle scripture. The effect and conditional enhanced effects of that rune last for the rest of the battle round. Each rune remains on your battle scripture for the rest of the battle or until it is removed or replaced by another ability. Varinor, Rune of Strength: Pick up to 2 friendly Lumineth Realm-lords units for each instance of this rune depicted on your battle scripture to be the targets. Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for each target. In addition, the following enhanced effects apply: • While Ydriliqi, Rune of the River is depicted on your battle scripture, add 1 to wound rolls for each target's combat attacks. • While Oreali, Rune of the Wind is depicted on your battle scripture, each target can use Shoot and/or Charge abilities even if it used a Retreat ability in the same turn. Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain: Pick up to 2 friendly Lumineth Realm-lords units for each instance of this rune depicted on your battle scripture to be the targets. Each target has Ward (5+). In addition, the following enhanced effects apply: • While Varinor, Rune of Strength is depicted on your battle scripture, the targets' melee weapons have Anti-charge (+1 Rend). • While Ydriliqi, Rune of the River is depicted on your battle scripture,subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with any of the targets. Ydriliqi, Rune of the River: Pick up to 2 friendly Lumineth Realm-lords units for each instance of this rune depicted on your battle scripture to be the targets. Subtract 2 from charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of any of the targets. In addition, the following enhanced effects apply: • While Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain is depicted on your battle scripture, ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made by the targets. • If Oreali, Rune of the Wind is depicted on your battle scripture, each target can immediately move 3". They can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. Oreali, Rune of the Wind: Pick up to 2 friendly Lumineth Realm-lords units for each instance of this rune depicted on your battle scripture to be the targets. Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with any of the targets. In addition, the following enhanced effects apply: • While Varinor, Rune of Strength is depicted on your battle scripture, add 4" to each target's Move characteristic. • While Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain is depicted on your battle scripture, add 5 to each target's control score. Thalari, Rune of the Zenith: Add 2 to casting rolls for friendly Lumineth Realm-lords units. In addition, if you have 4 or more unique runes depicted on your battle scripture, add 4" to the Move characteristic of friendly Lumineth Realm-lords units and friendly Lumineth Realm-lords units' attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+. Designer's Note: *We recommend noting the runes you have inscribed in each battle round on a piece of paper to keep track of which are currently depicted on your battle scripture. Feel free to note them by type (Strength, River, Mountain etc.), by initial (each has a different first letter) or if you are feeling particularly adventurous, you can try your hand at aelven calligraphy and learn to draw each rune!*

abilities.name: Ancient Spirits
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Lumineth Realm-lords Monster to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each visible friendly Lumineth Realm-lords unit in each phase while it is wholly within 12" of the target.

abilities.name: Trick of the Light
abilities.effect: Friendly Lumineth Realm-lords units can use the 'Power Through' command even if they have not charged this turn.

abilities.name: Arcane Focus
abilities.effect: Spell abilities from the Lore of Hysh or the Lore of the Awakened Realms used by friendly Lumineth Realm-lords Wizards have the Unlimited keyword. However, you cannot pick the same unit to be the target of the same Spell ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: Strike as One
abilities.effect: When players are alternating picking units to use a Fight ability, when it is your turn to pick a unit, you can pick 2 friendly Lumineth Realm-lords units instead of 1. Resolve the second Fight ability immediately after the first.

abilities.name: Acolyte of the Runes
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Lumineth Realm-lords Hero wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: That Hero can be picked as an additional target the next time you use the 'Depict Rune' ability.

abilities.name: Flawless Commander
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly Lumineth Realm-lords Infantry units wholly within 18" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Each target can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

abilities.name: Masterful Tactician
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Redeploy' command for a friendly Lumineth Realm‑lords unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilities.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

abilities.name: Phoenix Stone
abilities.effect: The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, Heal (D3) this unit.

abilities.name: Silver Wand
abilities.effect: If this unit is not a Wizard, it can use the 'Unbind' ability as if it had Wizard (1). Otherwise, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.

abilities.name: Waystone
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Overwhelming Heat
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Lumineth Realm‑lords Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Halve the target's Move characteristic until the start of your next turn, then roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target's Save characteristic, inflict D3 mortal damage on it.

abilities.name: Piercing Refraction
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Lumineth Realm‑lords Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Beacon of Hysh
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Lumineth Realm‑lords Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly non-Monster Lumineth Realm‑lords unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, if the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets that friendly unit is 1-3, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

abilities.name: Elemental Push
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Lumineth Realm‑lords Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly Lumineth Realm-lords unit wholly within 12" of them that was not set up this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Subtract 1 from the roll if the target is in combat.
abilities.effect: The target can move up to 5". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Realmshield
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Lumineth Realm‑lords Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly Lumineth Realm-lord units have Ward (5+) while they are wholly within 12" of the caster.

abilities.name: Focused Erosion
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Lumineth Realm‑lords Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target's weapons until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Summon Hyshian Twinstones
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Hyshian Twinstones endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Lumineth Realm‑lords Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Hyshian Twinstones endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Rune of Petrification
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Rune of Petrification on the battlefield, pick a friendly Lumineth Realm‑lords Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Rune of Petrification wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Summon Sanctum of Amyntok
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Sanctum of Amyntok on the battlefield, pick a friendly Lumineth Realm‑lords Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Sanctum of Amyntok wholly within 12" of the caster and more than 3" from all enemy units. A Sanctum of Amyntok has 3 parts that must be set up touching each other so that they form a ring.

abilities.name: Reservoir of Power
abilities.effect: Each time a unit (friendly or enemy) successfully casts a spell while it is within 12" of this Manifestation, give this Manifestation 1 arcane charge point. This Manifestation can have a maximum of 6 arcane charge points.

abilities.name: Release Arcane Charge
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Spell or Unbind ability for a Lumineth Realm-lords Wizard within 3" of this Manifestation
abilities.effect: Add this Manifestation's arcane charge points to the casting roll or unbinding roll. Then, reset this Manifestation's arcane charge points to 0.

abilities.name: Turn to Stone
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 6" of this Manifestation. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If an enemy unit has at least 3 mortal damage inflicted on it by this ability this turn, it has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Sigil of Yngra
abilities.effect: While a friendly unit with a Health characteristic of 10 or less is wholly inside the ring formed by this Manifestation: • That unit is not visible to enemy units that are not within its combat range. • Enemy abilities that would target this unit must target this Manifestation instead.

abilities.name: Summon Aethervoid Pendulum
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Aethervoid Pendulumon the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an Aethervoid Pendulum wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Summon Chronomantic Cogs
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Chronomantic Cogs endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Chronomantic Cogs endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Summon Quicksilver Swords
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Quicksilver Swords endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Quicksilver Swords endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
